transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I'm a building cleaner, and I'm here because... the thought of seeing a rat has just gotten so bad that I can't do parts of my job anymore. I mean, I logically know it's usually just an old building or a normal trash room, and it's not really dangerous, but the fear is just too much. I can't even go in there.
Is your fear mainly only when you might see a rat?

It's not just when I actually see one. Like, if I even just hear scratching near a wall, or... or see something move by a pipe, my whole body reacts right away. My heart starts pounding, my hands get shaky, and I just feel like I have to get out of there before I can even think straight.
Outside of situations where you might encounter a rat, do you still struggle with strong anxiety or worry?

No, not really. I mean, if I'm not at work or in a place where I think one might be... I'm fine. I don't really sit around worrying about other things in my life. It's just that one specific thing. As long as I know I'm somewhere safe from them, I feel completely normal.
